reddit.title: Exciting Updates: Ten Locales and Improved Placement in Provincia
reddit.body: We're thrilled to share some significant improvements in our latest update for Provincia! Our build UI now supports ten languages, making it more accessible to players around the world. Additionally, we've enhanced placement feedback, so you'll know exactly why a placement failed, and we've optimized day/night transitions to ensure smoother gameplay. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
